root_cause.text: The `i2c_imx_master_isr` interrupt service routine unconditionally overwrites the I2C controller state (`i2c_imx->state`) with `IMX_I2C_STATE_READ_CONTINUE` after executing `i2c_imx_isr_read_block_data_len`, which discards any error state (such as `IMX_I2C_STATE_FAILED`) set by the block length handler when an invalid block length is received.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `drivers/i2c/busses/i2c-imx.c`, the unconditional assignment `i2c_imx->state = IMX_I2C_STATE_READ_CONTINUE;` under the `IMX_I2C_STATE_READ_BLOCK_DATA_LEN` case is replaced with a conditional check `if (i2c_imx->state == IMX_I2C_STATE_READ_BLOCK_DATA_LEN)` to preserve any state changes made by `i2c_imx_isr_read_block_data_len(i2c_imx)`.
